summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.13/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.13 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 1, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 17¢ lower than a week ago, 40¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.39 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Janesville ($3.90) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.30).
